import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
import lightgbm as lgb
import catboost as cb

# Read data
train_df = pd.read_csv("input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("input/test.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("input/sample_submission.csv")

# Prepare features: drop id and high-cardinality feature f_27
feature_cols = [col for col in train_df.columns if col not in ["id", "f_27", "target"]]
X_train_raw = train_df[feature_cols].values.astype(np.float32)
y_train = train_df["target"].astype(np.int64)
X_test_raw = test_df[feature_cols].values.astype(np.float32)
test_ids = test_df["id"].values

# Split into train and validation (genuine hold-out)
X_train_full, X_val, y_train_full, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train_raw, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
)

# Apply StandardScaler on training data only
scaler = StandardScaler()
X_train_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(X_train_full)
X_val_scaled = scaler.transform(X_val)
X_test_scaled = scaler.transform(X_test_raw)

# Train CatBoost model
cat_params = {
    "objective": "Logistic",
    "eval_metric": "Logloss",
    "iterations": 1500,
    "learning_rate": 0.1,
    "depth": 6,
    "l2_leaf_reg": 3.0,
    "l1_leaf_reg": 0.0,
    "bagging_temperature": 0.75,
    "random_strength": 1.0,
    "seed": 42,
}
cat_model = cb.train(
    data=X_train_scaled,
    labels=y_train_full,
    cat_params=cat_params,
    valid_sets=[cb.PredictData(x=X_val_scaled, y=y_val)],
    callbacks=[cb.EarlyStopping(cycle=len([X_val_scaled]), mode="valid"))
)

# Train LightGBM model with tuned parameters
lgb_params = {
    "objective": "binary",
    "metric": "auc",
    "num_leaves": 64,
    "max_depth": 6,
    "min_child_samples": 20,
    "subsample": 0.8,
    "colsample_bytree": 0.8,
    "lambda_l1": 0.0,
    "lambda_l2": 0.0,
    "seed": 42,
}
lgb_dataset = lgb.Dataset(X_train_scaled, label=y_train_full)
lgb_param_callbacks = []
model = lgb.train(lgb_params, lgb_dataset, num_boost_round=1500, 
                 valid_sets=[lgb.Dataset(X_val_scaled, label=y_val)],
                 callbacks=lgb_param_callbacks)

# Predict on validation set
cat_pred_val = cat_model.predict(X_val_scaled)
lgb_pred_val = model.predict(X_val_scaled)

# Combined prediction is average of both models
val_combined = (cat_pred_val + lgb_pred_val) / 2
validation_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_combined)
print(f"Ensemble Validation AUC-ROC: {validation_auc:.6f}")

# Predict on test set
cat_pred_test = cat_model.predict(X_test_scaled)
lgb_pred_test = model.predict(X_test_scaled)
test_combined = (cat_pred_test + lgb_pred_test) / 2

# Save predictions
submission = pd.DataFrame({"id": test_ids, "target": test_combined})
submission.to_csv("submission/submission.csv", index=False)
